from pypdf import PdfReader
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,platform,sys
root=Path('research/implementation_runs/elite_impl_20261010_001/reference_fidelity')
records=[]
for name in ('gwu_retained_august_2025','fedsight_arxiv_2512_15728v1','takano_arxiv_2511_02469v1','acl_2025_findings_606'):
    path=root/'sources'/f'{name}.pdf'
    reader=PdfReader(path)
    pages=[{'pdf_page':i+1,'text':p.extract_text()} for i,p in enumerate(reader.pages)]
    out=root/'sources'/f'{name}_pages.json'
    out.write_text(json.dumps(pages,indent=2))
    text=root/'sources'/f'{name}.txt'
    text.write_text('\n\n'.join(f"=== PDF PAGE {p['pdf_page']} ===\n{p['text']}" for p in pages))
    records.append({'id':name,'pages':len(pages),'pdf_sha256':hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'page_extraction_file':str(out.relative_to(root)),'text_file':str(text.relative_to(root)),'extraction_sha256':hashlib.sha256(out.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
(root/'extraction_records.json').write_text(json.dumps({'python':sys.version,'platform':platform.platform(),'package':'pypdf','records':records},indent=2))
print(json.dumps(records,indent=2))
